sentences: When Tier-1 spawn_subagent is available, a Grok Build parent long PR wait via host monitor or shell pr:watch without a registered Approach 1 child fails closed or is redirected to Approach 1 admission.
evaluateReviewMonitorGate on !isTier1 consults sticky lease platform_primitive before EXIT_READY and does not greenlight no-monitor-required when a Tier-1 lease exists.
DEFT_MONITOR_TIER=3 override is labeled or refused so it is not byte-identical to honest generic-terminal READY.
Host/CLI subprocesses under Grok Build carry a durable Tier-1 capability stamp so verify cannot default to generic-terminal while spawn_subagent exists.
Approach 1 babysit-intent dispatch is the cheapest admitted path relative to recognized wrong forms; bounded-form deny covers deft/task pr:watch without --monitor-agent-id when Tier-1 is provable.
Bespoke unsanctioned %TEMP% pollers remain a named residual unless routed through deft-hook; do not claim total coverage without host admission.
Keep #3984 separate (no parent-turn-shape detector). Do not reopen #4529 implement stop-at:pr-open. Do not reopen the shipped #5219 false-claim join.
